About SK hynix America: 

 At SK hynix America, we are at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. As a global leader in HBM, DRAM, and NAND flash technologies, we develop the advanced memory solutions powering everything from advanced mobile technology to massive AI data centers. With major investments in the U.S. and a leading position in the global AI revolution, we build the critical infrastructure of the digital landscape and remain committed to sustainable operations. We invite innovative minds to be part of our journey. Here, you will be part of a collaborative team pioneering the next generation of memory technologies, expanding our market footprint, and defining the future of computing.

 Work Model: Onsite

 About This Role 

 SK hynix US AI DC Solutions is building and operating a 1~5 MW class AI Data Center testbed with LLM serving as the primary target workload. The team evaluates partner hardware/software technologies, defines optimal cluster configurations, and operates workloads and infrastructure services for next-generation AI/HPC systems.

 This posting is for the Junior-level position. A separate Senior-level posting is also available — please apply to the posting that matches your experience.

 Key Areas of Work 

 
 Infrastructure Operations: cluster, network, storage, and infra management software

 Performance Modeling & Simulation: system simulators, performance prediction, benchmarking

 AI Workload Operations (LLM Serving): serving engine deployment and system-level optimization

 
 Key Responsibilities 

 Infrastructure Operations

 
 Operate Kubernetes and Slurm-based clusters: provisioning, scheduling, and resource allocation in a multi-tenant GPU environment

 Operate asset, network, tenant, and VM management systems for the testbed

 Operate high-speed GPU fabrics (InfiniBand / RoCE) and storage tiering (object / parallel file / block)

 Support validation of partner hardware/software solutions and configuration decisions (GPU/CPU/memory ratio, network topology, storage tiering) under the guidance of senior engineers

 Build automation for deployment and operations (IaC, configuration management, observability)

 
 Performance Modeling & Simulation

 
 Implement, run, and maintain system simulators and analytical performance models predicting LLM serving throughput/latency (TTFT/TPOT), working under the guidance of senior engineers

 Collect and organize testbed measurement data to support model calibration

 Execute standardized AI training/inference benchmarks and support the regular evaluation process

 Profile workloads (Perf, VTune, Nsight) to identify bottlenecks across compute, memory, networking, and storage

 
 AI Workload Operations (LLM Serving)

 
 Deploy and operate LLM serving engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, Triton Inference Server)

 Tune serving configurations — GPU/memory/network settings, batching/scheduling parameters, resource allocation — to meet throughput and latency targets

 Build automated test infrastructure and reproducible benchmark environments (containers, CI pipelines)

 Execute workload experiments and report results against standardized benchmarks

 
 Required Qualifications    

 
 Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Engineering or related field

 3+ years in distributed systems, cluster computing, cloud infrastructure, ML systems, or performance engineering

 Linux administration and programming (Python; C/C++ a plus)

 Distributed systems fundamentals

 Working familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and/or batch schedulers (Slurm)

 Business-level English communication and documentation

 
 Required Expertise (at least one of the following) 

 
 Hands-on experience operating production K8s and/or Slurm clusters

 Experience with performance measurement, benchmarking, or system-level performance analysis

 LLM serving deployment and optimization with at least one framework (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, Triton)

 
 Preferred Qualifications 

 
 GPGPU/heterogeneous computing (CUDA, OpenCL)

 High-speed networking (InfiniBand/RoCE) and GPU cluster storage (Ceph, Lustre/GPFS); NoSQL

 LLM inference fundamentals (KV cache, batching, quantization, tensor/pipeline parallelism)

 Benchmark frameworks (MLPerf); IaC/observability (Terraform, Ansible, Prometheus, Grafana)

 AI/HPC data center operation experience; thermal and power efficiency optimization

 Publications in relevant systems/architecture venues

 
 Additional Requirement      

 
 
 Authorized to work in the US    



 
 
 Application Information 

 
 (Optional) You may indicate which of the three work areas is closest to your background.

 


 Benefits: 

 
 Top Tier health insurance at no employee cost

 Paid day offs: Paid Time Off, Company Holidays, Parental Leave, Happy Fridays

 401k Matching

 Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for Health Care & Dependent Care

 Educational reimbursement up to $10,000 per year

 Donation Matching and volunteering opportunities

 Corporate discount programs

 Free Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner provided to employees

 Compensation: 

 Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. Pay within the provided range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related skills and experience. Your Recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.

 Pay Range
 $90,000 — $130,000 USD 


 Equal Employment Opportunity: 

 SK hynix America is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender identity, national origin, color, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

 In compliance with federal law, SK hynix America also participates in the federal E-Verify program. Upon accepting an offer of employment, all newly hired individuals will be required to complete Form I-9, which includes verifying identity and legal authorization to work in the United States. Please review the official government posters detailing your rights and protections prior to applying:

 
 E-Verify Participation Poster (Bilingual English & Spanish) 

 IER Right to Work Poster (English) 

 IER Right to Work Poster (Spanish)
